page_title: UDI 1-0 NAP | Udinese v Napoli 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
90+5' A lofted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+4' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli will be replaced by Saba Goglichidze (Udinese).
90+4' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
90+3' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Nicolo Zaniolo is replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
88' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar.
86' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 40:60.
84' That will be all from Nicolo Bertola who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
83' The substitution has been made. Adam Buksa (Udinese) has replaced Keinan Davis.
83' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Jurgen Ekkelenkamp and he is replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
83' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) replacing Eljif Elmas.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Leonardo Spinazzola as he is replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
82' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matteo Politano (Napoli).
80' A pass from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
80' An attempted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
78' Shots on target – 5:0.
77' Scott McTominay (Napoli) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
77' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.

77' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Buongiorno trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
73' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the top right corner.
71' Celebrations are cut short for Udinese as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
70' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Udinese goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
69' Goal! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
68' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp plays a lovely pass into Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
66' David Neres (Napoli) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
66' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find Eljif Elmas, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
63' Keinan Davis (Udinese) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
61' It's time for a substitution. Matteo Politano (Napoli) comes on in place of Sam Beukema.
61' Substitution. Noa Lang will be replaced by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).
59' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
58' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
56' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese have a free kick.
54' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Udinese due to an offside in the build-up play.
54' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Udinese goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
52' The goalkeeper makes a superb save, but the ball rebounds off him out to Keinan Davis (Udinese), who slots the ball into the bottom right corner.
50' The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a throw-in.
47' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Simone Sozza has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The ball has crossed the sideline. Napoli are taking a throw-in.
42' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
40' 53:47 – the ratio of ball possession.
40' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
37' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
34' The ball is behind the touchline and Udinese will take a throw-in.
33' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
29' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

29' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
29' One of the Udinese players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
26' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
25' Oumar Solet (Udinese) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
23' Oumar Solet (Udinese) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
21' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
20' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) is able to continue to play.
19' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' A clumsy foul by Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) and Simone Sozza blows his whistle.
17' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
15' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
14' Noa Lang (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
13' A player from Udinese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
11' Noa Lang (Napoli) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
11' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.
10' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Napoli earn a corner.
9' A player from Napoli commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
6' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' One of the Udinese players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
3' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
3' It's a throw-in for Udinese.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
